hypotheses.name: STRING + ontology support interaction for geometric utility
hypotheses.method: On seed42 across immune/lung/external_lung and source/target-disjoint splits at layers {0,3,7,11}, fit baseline vs interaction logistic models using geometry features and a support score combining DoRothEA + STRING API score + GO overlap + OmniPath + ontology-profile similarity; used stratified support permutations within degree x coexpression x geodesic x ontology bins.
hypotheses.result_value: +0.23253 overall; 4/6 domain-splits Fisher-significant; mean AUROC delta ~ 0
hypotheses.next_action: Replicate on seeds 43/44 and require non-negative held-out domain AUROC delta alongside positive interaction coefficients.

hypotheses.name: True split-zigzag persistence with target-set permutation controls
hypotheses.method: Using dionysus true zigzag persistence on source->union<-target kNN edge complexes for seed42 domains/layers {0,3,7,11}, computed H1 total lifetime and compared against target-set permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: +234.78 mean observed-minus-null H1 lifetime; 12/12 rows positive; 3/3 domains Fisher-significant
hypotheses.next_action: Increase permutation budget (>=160) and test whether zigzag excess predicts downstream edge-utility uplift.

hypotheses.name: Robust OOS intrinsic-dimension/local-linearity validation
hypotheses.method: From H38 moment features, evaluated leave-layer-out and leave-seed-out robust deltas (winsorized and trimmed R2) for full vs mean-only models, with permutation nulls and block sign-bootstrap nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: winsorized +10.8848 with 6/12 permutation-significant rows, but 0/12 block-bootstrap significant; trimmed mean -65.4611 with instability
hypotheses.next_action: Do not promote; only revisit with materially changed robust target/holdout design and explicit handling of trimmed-metric underpowering.
